item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Next-generation elastic architecture for Azure Application Gateway v2
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway v2 has a public preview of a next-generation elastic architecture. Microsoft says it can cut provisioning time by up to 50% and autoscaling time by up to 70% for demanding, dynamic workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates
